attributes.context: This is part of Article 37 Management Rights, which reserves broad employer authority over functions, organization, budget, workforce, policies, work methods, positions, scheduling, training, layoffs, and discipline, and Section 37.2 requires that exercise of those rights be consistent with the Agreement.

extraction_text:
37.1 The Employer retains all rights of management, which, in addition to all powers, duties and rights established by constitutional provision or statute, will include but not be limited to, the right to:

A. Determine the Employer’s functions, programs, organizational structure and use of technology;
